lines.2: The rest would have to wait until tomorrow.
lines.3: First, apply a base coat of rust inhibitor.
lines.4: Second, paint it after that dries.
lines.5: Third, it should be finished... apparently.
lines.7: I rejoined Konoe after she'd changed.
lines.8: 「Walking you partway home is part of my orders too.」
lines.9: I couldn't exactly escort her without an excuse like that.
lines.16: We chatted as we headed toward the station.
lines.20: 「My place is just past the station.」
lines.21: Konoe and I had gone to the same middle school, so she was local too.
lines.22: 「Got it. Then I'll head off here.」
lines.25: 「...Even if you only helped because you were ordered to, you were still a big help.」
lines.37: 「You... shouldn't you be heading home by now?」
lines.43: There was absolutely no getting through to this one.
lines.44: Well, that ought to take care of the school-gate problem.
